name: Centro Cultural Tijuana
funding: Federal state company under Mexico's culture ministry. Modified budget MXN 132.9M for January to September 2025, of which MXN 88.0M accrued. A private patronato supports it.

name: National Art Museum of Moldova
funding: State museum subordinate to Moldova's Ministry of Culture.

name: Villa des Arts de Casablanca
funding: Run by Fondation Al Mada, the corporate foundation of Al Mada, the royal family's holding company. Le360 (10 May 2023) says it manages the Casablanca and Rabat villas.

name: LE 18, Derb el Ferrane
funding: Artist-run space founded 2013, documenta fifteen lumbung member. Funders not published.

name: L'Appartement 22
funding: Founded by curator Abdellah Karroum. Supported through non-commercial international research grants, Prince Claus Fund, and independent publishing sales.

name: Le Cube – independent art room
funding: Small artist-run space founded 2005 by Elisabeth Piskernik; residencies paid by artists, partners are foreign cultural institutes and embassies.

name: Associação Núcleo de Arte
funding: Artists' association with over 100 members. State funding ended in the civil war; a late-1990s profile names Hivos as donor. No current funder list is published.

name: Franco-Namibian Cultural Centre (FNCC)
funding: Binational centre under Namibian law, funded by the French government. Namibia gave the land and France paid for the building; foundation stone laid in 1998.

name: Heroes' Acre (Windhoek)
funding: Namibian government paid Mansudae N$60 million against a N$34 million budget. Opened 26 August 2002. The National Heritage Council runs it; adult Namibians paid N$50 in 2024-25.

name: Independence Memorial Museum
funding: Paid for by the Namibian government and built by Mansudae from 2009; it opened in March 2014. Entry is free and a culture ministry heritage official speaks for it.

name: Kathmandu Triennale
funding: Siddhartha Arts Foundation with Nepal Academy of Fine Arts (2026); 2022 edition backed by embassies, Saraf Foundation, Gorkha Brewery, Himalayan Bank, Toyota.
